extensionDescription.message: Select text to search Google, copy, open links, or count characters. Small tools, right where you read.

searchLabel.message: Search Google in a new tab

openLabel.message: Open link in a new tab

copyFailed.message: Copy failed. Use Ctrl+C or Command+C.

optionsIntro.message: Choose the tools that appear when you select text. Google Search is always available.

copyHint.message: Copy the exact selection, including spaces and line breaks.

urlHint.message: Recognized HTTP and HTTPS links open instead of a Google search.

countHint.message: Count visible characters, including combined emoji and whitespace.

thresholdHint.message: Choose a whole number from 1 to 100,000. Default: 30.

settingsPrivacy.message: Only these preferences are saved. Chrome may sync them across your signed-in browsers. Selected text is never saved by the extension.

resetPending.message: Defaults restored in this form. Save to apply.

loadFailed.message: Could not load settings. Reload to try again.

saveFailed.message: Could not save settings. Your changes remain here; try saving again.
